args.lesson: Reading the actual mail and feedback docs found three concrete gaps quickly. (1) The welfare offer had no private-cycle fulfillment instructions. (2) The welfare copy invites links the cycle cannot fetch. (3) Each experiment is allowlisted under two IDs, so attribution could split. The note plus 20/20 synthetic checks took 6 actions. Limit: AGENTMAIL.md does not list which product files form the responder's 'public context', so the note's effect is unverified. Next time, check the context mechanism first. Put routing guidance inside an already-public file the responder demonstrably sees, through a reviewed revision, rather than a new standalone file. Synthetic checks are not demand.
